name: area-chart
title: Area chart · Tremor Raw
description: Copy-and-paste area chart UI for dashboard cards and reports. Adapt its palette, labels and component props to the project's brand and real data.
install: Copy the public Tremor Raw AreaChart component and helpers from https://www.tremor.so/docs/visualizations/area-chart; follow its per-component dependency instructions.
notes: Tremor Raw, Apache-2.0 with MIT notices for listed subcomponents. Public component: https://github.com/tremorlabs/tremor/tree/main/src/components/AreaChart. This is manual source integration, not a package/registry install. Do not substitute the legacy @tremor/react package or paid Tremor Blocks. Source/docs checked; runtime integration remains unverified.
